channel.title: Chain Times
channel.description: Chain Times reports crypto news: bitcoin and ether markets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: Tether CEO puts its bitcoin holdings at 150,000
item.description: Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino says the company holds about 150,000 bitcoin, far above the amount implied by its latest reserve report, with the gap unexplained.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview helped hackers steal $6.34 billion
item.description: Binance says hackers stole $6.34 billion after a fake job interview helped them reach wallet systems, exposing how staff access can put customer assets at risk.

item.title: Binance customers pull $4.72 billion after $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance says hackers stole about $6.3 billion and it will cover the loss; customers have withdrawn $4.72 billion since withdrawals resumed.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet breach caused $6.3 billion loss
item.description: Binance says attackers took about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets, prompting a withdrawal halt as it secures systems and works to recover assets.

item.title: Binance estimates $6.3 billion impact from security incident
item.description: Binance says a security incident may have used an engineer’s compromised laptop to trigger unauthorized withdrawals, with about $3 billion frozen so far.

item.title: Binance plans phased withdrawals after $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance says it is reopening withdrawals in stages after a $6.3 billion hack, and has replaced about 95% of affected assets with company funds so far.

item.title: Binance reports $6.3bn theft in record crypto breach
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets, prompting a withdrawal freeze as it works to recover funds and cover user losses.

item.title: Binance pauses deposits and withdrawals after $6.3B breach
item.description: Binance paused deposits and withdrawals while investigating a security breach; the exchange says about $3 billion in affected assets has been frozen so far.

item.title: Chainlink brings tokenized asset pricing to weekends
item.description: Chainlink adds weekend pricing for tokenized assets, giving Aave’s Horizon platform a way to value collateral while traditional markets are closed.

item.title: Bitcoin slips below $80,000 as tech jitters and Fed dissent weigh
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as Samsung shares slid and two Fed officials backed a rate rise, adding fresh pressure to crypto and leveraged traders.

item.title: Janus Henderson puts Nasdaq-100 fund JQQQ on Stellar
item.description: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launched JQQQ, a Nasdaq-100 fund issued on Stellar under Nasdaq license, giving eligible non-U.S. investors onchain exposure.

item.title: Ripple gets final OCC approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple says the OCC gave its national trust bank final approval, putting RLUSD reserve management under federal supervision while its New York firm keeps issuing the stablecoin.

item.title: What zerofi Does When an XMR Transfer Is Pending
item.description: zerofi turns XMR into a token for Ethereum, but a sent Monero payment is only the first step; confirmation, processing and minting can all take time.

item.title: How a Business Should Size a SushiSwap DCA Order
item.description: Set a fixed budget first, then choose each SushiSwap DCA trade and its timing around cash needs, fees and the risk of buying through a price move.

item.title: Aviva adds £22bn sterling fund share class to XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors has launched a tokenized share class of its £22 billion sterling fund on the XRP Ledger, adding blockchain-based access while keeping the fund structure off-chain.

item.title: Aviva tokenises £22bn sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors has put a tokenised share class of its £22bn sterling fund on XRP Ledger, adding an on-chain route into a money market fund for eligible investors.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC's stablecoin rule keeps issuer-paid interest banned but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, shaping how crypto platforms can pay customers.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin on PayMe in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC has launched its first Hong Kong dollar stablecoin on PayMe, giving more than 3.3 million users a new way to send money and pay merchants.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, replacing its voting system with a design targeting 150-millisecond finality and faster settlement for payments and trades.

item.title: OCC rule leaves crypto exchanges room to offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC says stablecoin issuers cannot pay holders interest, but exchanges may share earnings through rewards, leaving the key yield fight to case-by-case review.
